title: Superset Weekly Active User Trend
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`) and REST API events.
app: Superset application and Celery worker logs via UF; Superset REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=superset:app
| timechart span=1w dc(user) as active_users
| eventstats avg(active_users) as avg_users
| eval below_trend=if(active_users<avg_users*0.85,1,0)
description: Trends the number of distinct weekly active users of Superset and flags weeks where engagement drops below trend, an early signal of eroding adoption or an access problem.
value: Adoption is the return on a BI investment; a declining active-user trend for Superset surfaces churn before a renewal or rationalisation review.
implementation: Ingest Superset usage/activity events; schedule weekly and review adoption dips with the platform owner.
visualization: Timechart of Superset weekly active users with trend band.
grandmaExplanation: We track how many people actually use Superset each week so a drop in usage is noticed early.
